digest.component_or_area: DC sub-task parent synchronization and outbound field emission
propositions: DC 8.17.1 accepts PUT fields.parent on a sub-task but silently ignores it; nulling the parent is rejected with HTTP 400 and sub-task editmeta exposes no parent field
_resolve_local_parent returns (False, None) for a non-epic parent, indistinguishable from unbound parent, causing the field to be suppressed with no durable operator-visible signal or bridge alert
Three live test cells never passed in 12 consecutive harness runs due to wrong oracles: they assert platform-unsupported operations (sub-task reparent) rather than rebar defects
Re-homing the three cells to Epic Link operations on non-sub-task children preserves test subject (parent sync end-to-end outcome) while using only supported DC mechanisms
Suppressed non-epic parent changes that diverge from the tracker must record an outbound-field-dropped bridge alert instead of silently exiting with convergence reported
The fix implements missing 39c1 AC4 completion: emit-time suppression must produce durable records via the existing dropped_field_sink, reusing acd0 precedent without new plumbing
